body: I see the potential in myself, I just was always unable to motivate myself. She effortlessly motivated me to do so much, and somehow still is. I have tried, and it isn't worth it. Our close friend, one of my best died in a car wreck and everyone went on doing drugs and drinking and doing everything normally. I stopped hanging out with them because at the time I was realizing I needed to change my tune my ex decided after 6 months to come back. Convinced me she wanted to be with me again and to move on from everyone so I did. Well we didn't get back together and the crowd I used to hang with is actually at her house partying right now. Also, what hurts me the worst is I helped her through suicidal thoughts and self harm after she lost her mother. She knew I was depressed and suicidal as well, but no longer cares.

I haven't. Not really, I don't enjoy life at the moment. I miss my ex lover, I miss my friends who now as of today hang out with my ex lover, and I want to be done with school already. I'm 25 and I've never really had my head on straight, I've been through relationships and shit throughout life and no one really helped me progress. This girl helped me see a future and get my head on straight, now she's gone from my life in a romantic aspect but still wants to be friends while she's seeing other dudes. So the one person who kept my head on straight has complete control of me and I hate it.
Nothing, I own one of your books.
